title: Fiqh of Salah (Prayer)
description: Detailed study of the jurisprudence (fiqh فقه) of Salah (صلاة) - the prayer - including its conditions (شرائط), pillars (أركان), sunnahs (سنن), and common mistakes. Learn the authentic rulings from the Qur'an and Sunnah.
short_description: Master the rulings and practice of the five daily prayers

modules.title: Foundation of Salah
modules.description: Understanding the importance, virtues, and timing of the five daily prayers.

lessons.title: Rewards, Punishment & Perfect Timing
lessons.content: The tremendous rewards of Salah (صلاة) and the warnings for missing it. Understanding the divine wisdom behind the specified prayer times (أوقات الصلاة).

lessons.title: The Times of Prayer
lessons.content: Detailed explanation of the five prayer times as taught by Jibreel (عليه السلام) to the Prophet (صلّ الله عليه وسلّم), including when each prayer begins and ends.

lessons.title: The Call to Prayer (Adhan)
lessons.content: Understanding the Adhan (أذان) - its virtues, rulings, and the meanings of its words.

modules.title: Conditions of Salah
modules.description: The prerequisites that must be fulfilled before the prayer is valid.

lessons.title: Purification of Body, Clothing & Place
lessons.content: The conditions of Taharah (طهارة) - purification - including Wudu (وضوء), Ghusl (غسل), and ensuring one's clothing and prayer place are free from impurity.

lessons.title: Facing the Qiblah & Awrah
lessons.content: The ruling of facing the Qiblah (قبلة) - the direction of Masjid al-Haram - and the requirements of covering one's Awrah (عورة).

lessons.title: The Intention (Niyyah)
lessons.content: Understanding Niyyah (نية) - the intention - its place in the heart, and why it is a condition for every act of worship.

modules.title: Pillars and Sunnahs of Salah
modules.description: The obligatory and recommended actions within the prayer itself.

lessons.title: The Pillars (Arkan) of Salah
lessons.content: The eight pillars of Salah (أركان الصلاة): standing, Takbir, recitation, Ruku', Sujud, Jalsah, and the Tashahhud.

lessons.title: The Sunnah Acts of Salah
lessons.content: The recommended actions (سنن الصلاة) that complete and perfect the prayer, including raising hands, saying 'Ameen', and the Taslim.

lessons.title: Common Mistakes in Salah
lessons.content: Addressing common mistakes (أخطاء شائعة) in prayer that affect its validity or completeness, with solutions from the authentic Sunnah.
